chapter: Leading his own band in New York
title: Club Afrique and losing his men to another leader
summary: After Barnes Tavern he plays Club Afrique; another leader raids his band and he later plays the Black Cat.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: So the first job you had was the Barnes Tavern. Now after the Barnes Tavern you got the Club Afrique; that's the next job, right?
Afrique; right.
That job lasted you what, another two months?
It lasted a lot of months.
This is where you still have the same guys basically, Skeets--
No, no.
You changed.
(Inaudible) took some of my men.
He took Taddy Smith?
Right.
And maybe a couple of the other guys.
He took my band almost.
That's what I was going to say; he took your band, just about.
Yeah, he was a real louse.
Yeah, I would imagine you didn't get along too well.
I guess I was just too easy.
That's probably what it was.
Some people take niceness for weakness.
He played down at the Black Cat, I think, down in the Village, down on Houston Street?
Yeah, I later went into the Black Cat too.
Oh, you went into the Black Cat too?
